QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] The Precipice
QuestInfo.0: In this revised timeline, the boy who would have grown up to pilot the ultimate weapon instead disappeared from history in 2095. What could have happened to him in peacetime? Travel to his time and place and find out.
QuestInfo.1: You find the future pilot in a city park, under attack from machines -- not war machines, but industrial robots. Why are they after him? No time to wonder now; they have the park surrounded, and they're closing in. In a stroke of luck, the boy is an inventor's son, and he built a heat-sensing radar, which you could use to find a clear path through the machines -- if he hadn't already dropped it when the attack began. See if you can find it, then get him out of harm's way.
QuestInfo.2: You recovered the #t4032158# and turned it on, only to see a huge group of contacts coming in fast. This is going to get worse before it gets better...
